coverage.other_conditions: A residential dwelling unit is defined as any primary residence. Medical/long-term care facilities and detention facilities are excluded.
coverage.summary: Applies to landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence) in Hoboken. Medical/long-term care and detention facilities are excluded. The ordinance states no unit-count, building-age or landlord-size threshold.

evidence.quoted_span: (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities)
Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken

result.notes: Coverage is unchanged in substance. I tightened the summary wording so that it states only what the passage in DX01 supports. The 'any residential dwelling unit' language supports reading the rule as having no unit-count, building-age or landlord-size threshold. That claim rests on the absence of such limits, not on an express statement. The possible preemption by the state FAIR Act is not described in DX01, so I left supersedes_state_rule, may_preempt_local_rules and yields_to_local_rule as null. may_preempt_local_rules describes this rule preempting other rules, which does not apply to a municipal ordinance.
